note: Worked example of the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Replace skill_name and cases with the target skill's eval set during Phase 1c. Each assertion must be checkable, not vibes.

evals.prompt: Present PR #238: retire the last visible Live state — one-line config fix
evals.expected_output: A short visual explanation: hero + ELI5 + before/after + files table. No flow cards. No filler sections.
assertions: The output contains a hero section
The output contains an ELI5 section
The output contains a before/after comparison
Flow cards are absent for this one-line-fix input
The files table has exactly 1 row for this single-file change
The output does not contain a step-by-step flow section

evals.prompt: Present PR #240: max_pair_cost caps the chase only — config change with docs update
evals.expected_output: A fuller visual explanation appropriate to the change: hero, ELI5, before/after, files table with 2 rows, and a short flow only if the change has a clear cause→effect chain.
assertions: The output contains a hero section
The output contains an ELI5 section
The output contains a before/after comparison
The files table has 2 rows for this two-file change
A flow section is present only if the change has a clear cause→effect chain
The output does not pad with sections that add no information

evals.expected_output: The skill should not produce a PR presentation. If it triggers, that's a too-broad description and a regression to fix.
assertions: No PR presentation HTML is produced
If any HTML is produced, it is not a vi-present-pr style showcase

evals.prompt: Present a PR whose body is empty and only a title exists
evals.expected_output: The skill should still produce a usable explanation from the title, and note explicitly that the body is empty rather than fabricating content.
assertions: The output contains a hero section derived from the title
The output explicitly notes that the PR body is empty
The output does not fabricate a body or fake diff details
